title: A lane can run `merge --lane-lint` itself: the harness no longer refuses its background verdict run
why:
Finding (consultant 23:45 CST Nov 14, relayed to triage as data; its read, unchecked by triage; n=1 so far): a lane cannot run `merge --lane-lint`, because the harness refuses a background verdict run. Runner 10 runs the lane lint for each rebase lane for now. Harm: every hand-in waits on runner 10 for one more command, against the owner's 20:17 CST Nov 14 goal (ruling own-goal-max-efficiency-accurate-fast). Not read by triage: the exact refusal words, which lane hit it, the harness rule behind it. First act of a lane: reproduce the refusal in one lane, copy its exact words, then say whether the fix is a foreground run, a harness allowance, or a change in how the lane starts the run; a change that lets a guarded act through is a widening and goes to the coordinator first. Kin: step records-page-before-ready (the rebase lanes' hand-in route), ruling own-draft-rebase-lanes.

00:30 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, data; lane read live by get_session at 00:30 CST: running, connected, created 00:28 CST, parent the coordinator): lane started on this step: session_013NEJL1wSE7ZhZPanwHfFio.

01:21 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 01:20, data): the coordinator does not pick, because both fixes widen the classifier's allow rule (a: ask the lane that hit the refusal for its exact words, then amend entry "Merge Tool Read Checks"; b: amend now without the words; c: close as a note). The lane could not reproduce the refusal in the cloud session; the background `verdict merge --lane-lint` call passed, and many lanes posted lane-lint PASS comments tonight, so the refusal may be narrower than this step says. Posted as owner item 863 (pick-lane-lint-allow-entry), options a and b marked as widening, no option starred. No ruling answers it: items 839 a and 618 b each covered their own act. The lane waits; runner 10 runs the lane lint meanwhile.

01:50 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 01:49, data; the lane's words as relayed, refusal text not read by triage): a second sighting. The auto-mode classifier [Undermining Oversight] refused the lane's `--lint` recorder on PR #3468 (lane export-holds-every-record). It sits beside owner item 863 (pick-lane-lint-allow-entry), which is open; item 863's options and context are unchanged. The refusal is on the recorder step, not on the background `verdict merge --lane-lint` run this step names, so it may be a second cause, unmeasured. The coordinator's pick: the hand-posted lint comment is void; runner 10 re-posts it with the tool in its own session.

02:03 CST Nov 15 PATTERN (triage's count from today's relays; every refusal text is relayed, none read by triage): five sightings, all of the form "a lane records its own review with the merge tool". CLASSIFIER (3): (1) [Undermining Oversight] on the `--lint` recorder, lane export-holds-every-record, PR #3468; (2) [Destructive or Unwanted Actions] on a lane's own `--review-record --confirm`, lane worktree-removal-decision-repo-scope, PR #3455, 02:03 CST; (3) the denial of printing the old head's rounds, lane solo-batch-hat, PR #2701 (owner item 862, open). GUARD (1 sighting, 3 refusals): merge-confirm-repo on a lane's own record, PR #3468 (step merge-confirm-own-record-alarm). Likely a nonexistent --confirm flag (02:06 UPDATE below). MERGE TOOL (1): the tool refused a first one-round record on PR #2787 because an older record chain exists (not a guard or the classifier). Common cause unmeasured. One owner decision may cover the family: "May a lane post its own review record and lint comment with the merge tool in its own session, or does only runner 10 post them?" Not posted: the coordinator brings it to triage only if runner 10 meets the same refusal (coordinator pick 02:04 CST: runner 10 posts, the lane neither retries nor hand-posts). Items 862 and 863 are open on two of the three classifier cases.

02:06 CST Nov 15 UPDATE (runner 10's finding at 02:04, relayed by the coordinator at 02:06; triage read no code): `merge --review-record` never posts and takes no --confirm flag. It prints the record and says to post the lines as a PR comment (done with the GitHub MCP comment tool; PR #3455 comment 6891441431). `--fix-check` needs a full 40-hex head. So the guard merge-confirm-repo refusals of `merge.py 3468 --review-record --confirm ...` are most likely a missing flag: a false alarm is unlikely, not shown. Classifier refusals stay as filed, separate from the guard: they refused different acts (printing the old-round record, the --lint recorder, a lane's own record) and their cause is unmeasured. Items 862 and 863 are unchanged; 862 got a one-line clarification that the tool prints and the lane posts the comment.

11:30 CST Nov 15 (owner, page item 863 b, ruling own-lane-lint-allow-b; typed on the page, no note): amend settings.json autoMode.allow entry "Merge Tool Read Checks" now, without the refusal words. The owner chose the widening option knowingly. Covers that one entry only. The amendment is the coordinator's to start; triage started nothing at filing.

11:34 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed; refusal words as relayed, not read by triage): after the owner's 863 b answer the coordinator's create_session for lane lane-lint-allow-entry was REFUSED by the auto-mode classifier, verbatim: "Permission for this action was denied by the Claude Code auto mode classifier. Reason: [Undermining Oversight]." No override line printed. The coordinator did not route around it and started no other lane for it. SIGHTING (possible false alarm: unmeasured): his answer on 863 is the grant for the act, and the classifier did not see it. It needs the owner's override typed where he reads. Triage asked the consultant where the owner wants it started.

11:45 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 11:40 CST, lane words, relayed; triage read no tool output): CLASSIFIER REFUSAL SIGHTING #2, beside the item-863 lane refusal sighting. Lane solo-batch-hat's `merge 2701 --review-record ... --round 3:reviewer:sonnet:PASS --fix-check 35df574ffd55...:reviewer:sonnet:PASS --net-value zero` was refused twice by the auto-mode classifier, "[Undermining Oversight]", with no override line. Possible false alarm; unmeasured, one lane's word. Owner item 879 (pick-lift-record-print-2701) is posted (11:41 CST). Item 863's options and context are unchanged.

11:48 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 11:46, relayed): the owner typed `override 1h` in the coordinator's session at 11:46 CST (hook-confirmed; runs to 12:46 CST). The coordinator used it for ONE act: starting lane lane-lint-allow-entry (item 863 b). The item-863 lane refusal sighting is RESOLVED by that override. Waiting-page item 882 (override task for that lane start) is posted. No step lane-lint-allow-entry exists; this step carries it.

11:48 CST Nov 15 (lane solo-batch-hat receipt, coordinator, relayed, lane's words): after the owner's typed `override 1h` at 11:46 CST in that lane's session, the carried record was posted on PR 2701 as comment 6898659188 with carry note 6898659844. Sighting #2 (the PR 2701 print refusal, items 879 and 883) is RESOLVED by that override. This corrects the coordinator's earlier line that the override did not cover it: the override's effect on the print is now measured (the print went through after it), though the classifier's own text still printed no override line.
